description: The Connect window (hosted plan §7.2): this app's own bundle talking to a hosted server. Narrowed on purpose (user decision, P5 review finding 10): window controls, notifications and the events its socket bridge needs — no dialog, drag, path, app, menu, tray or webview-creation plugin. Its app commands are narrowed in Rust too (`commands::connect::CONNECT_WINDOW_COMMANDS`). Scoped by webview label, never `remote`.
